premises.text: Existing cybersecurity solutions make humans responsible for security actions, which can hinder productivity.
premises.evidence_span: Existing cyber solutions make humans responsible for security actions, when in reality security actions often get in the way of getting a job done.

premises.text: Traditional data loss prevention tools take a long time to deploy.
premises.evidence_span: 98% of organizations take more than a few weeks, with almost half of them taking four months to over a year.

premises.text: Phalanx reduces the attack surface by securing unused files.
premises.evidence_span: If you have 1,000 files on your computer and you're only using one, then you expose that one while 999 files are secured by Phalanx.

premises.text: Phalanx is an identity-based solution that leverages automation for quick deployment.
premises.evidence_span: Phalanx is an identity-based solution that leverages automation, and that means we're deployable in less than a day and requires zero weekly maintenance.

premises.text: Phalanx provides visibility into file access across workspaces.
premises.evidence_span: Phalanx provides a digital map of every file across every existing workspace.

premises.text: Phalanx can restrict access to files based on location.
premises.evidence_span: If somebody's opening a file in a country that you don't have an office, you can restrict that from opening.

premises.text: Phalanx reduces cyber risk exposure for customers in specific sectors.
premises.evidence_span: We've reduced the cyber risk exposure of our customers in the financial services and government contracting sectors by over 60%.

premises.text: Phalanx has a dual-prong go-to-market strategy targeting both enterprises and SMBs.
premises.evidence_span: We also have a dual-prong go-to-market strategy where we focus on mid-to-large-scale enterprise by doing per-user requirements, so we're scalable with the needs of those security teams, and we can also deploy out to SMBs via the channel.

value.text: Phalanx enables organizations to secure their data while maintaining productivity.

notes: No external knowledge applied; all claims are based on the transcript.
